cd /workspace/submission && python3 - <<'PY'
import exact,time,resource,json
N=512;P=512;T=1;S=512;Q=1;O=0
links=[]
for l in range(1024):
    a=l%N;b=(a+1+(l//N))%N
    if a==b:b=(b+1)%N
    slot=l//N
    links.append({'ends':[[a,slot,0],[b,slot,1]],'delay_ns':[1,1],'defer_rounds':[0,0]})
fabric={'n':N,'interval_ns':T,'slice_ns':S,'offset_ns':O,'drift_ppb':[0]*N,'heat':[],'anchors':[[0,0,P]],'links':links,'slices':[list(range(1024))],'blackouts':[],'guards_ns':[0,16,64,128,192,255],'reconfig_ns':0}
prof={'groups':2,'jitter_ps':[0,0],'measurements':[[0,1,0,0]]}
cal=exact.solve_calibration(prof);fab=exact.Fabric(fabric)
t=time.time();art=exact.make_plan_artifact(fab,cal);print('make',time.time()-t,'guard',art['guard_ns'],'peaks',art['peaks_as'],'warm',art['warmup_cycle'])
print('artifact bytes est',len(json.dumps(art,separators=(',',':'))))
t=time.time();ok=exact.audit_plan(prof,fabric,art);print('audit',time.time()-t,ok,'mem',resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_SELF).ru_maxrss)
PY
